_comment: Stage-to-model assignments for the mixed arms. Every stage of every agent is named explicitly - a mix is a claim about which model does which job, so it is written out rather than inferred from stage names. make_mix.py generates <agent>-<mix> from these; run_quality.py selects one with an arm's `variant`. Model ids must exist in arms.json.

_design.loops: Stages that iterate with tools (gather, ingest, profile, compute, script, implement, prototype) dominate token spend, because each turn re-sends the working context. This is where a cheap model pays for itself.
_design.thinking: Stages that decide what to do (plan, analyze, reassess) are few calls over a small context. A frontier model here costs little and changes the outcome most.
_design.checking: Verification (verify, review) benefits from a strong model, and from being a different model than the one that did the work.
_design.recovery: Error recovery runs rarely; a strong model there is nearly free in aggregate and is exactly when capability matters.
_design.output: The output stage reformats what is already established. Cheapest capable model, held to the requested format.

econ._note: Cheapest defensible configuration: economy model in every loop, workhorse for thinking and checking.

frontier-brain._note: Cheap hands, expensive head: economy model in every loop, frontier model wherever a decision is made or checked - including recovery, which fires rarely enough that its capability is nearly free.
